parameters.content:
## Purpose
Turn a small catalog into downloadable concept PNGs with one audit manifest per SKU and a combined review summary. Designed for a human-reviewed creative pipeline: preserve which prompt produced which image and separate rejected or uncertain requests from completed assets.

## Setup
The default demo uses one tiny PNG fixture and one simulated rate-limit response; no AI image is generated and no credentials are needed on this branch. For live execution, configure the HTTP node with n8n Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY. Keep the key in credentials. Your account needs access to gpt-image-1 and sufficient API credit. In Configuration set live mode and explicitly enable allowPaidGeneration after reviewing current prices. The template is free; OpenAI requests are billable separately. Choose one of the listed output sizes and quality levels.

## Batch and recovery
All catalog rows are validated before any request. Each run accepts at most three unique SKUs. Live requests run one at a time with a short interval. Automatic POST retries are off to reduce duplicate spending. Each successful base64 response is validated as PNG, converted into an n8n binary and named by SKU. Rejections, malformed results and uncertain transport outcomes remain in the manifest. Download files from the final node. Before retrying, remove successful SKUs and inspect provider usage for uncertain outcomes; no cross-run deduplication is provided.

## Review before publishing
These are concept illustrations, not faithful photographs of supplied physical products: no reference photo is uploaded. Check shape, labels and claims manually. The workflow never publishes or uploads externally. Retain the output before execution history expires.

## Attribution
Created by Shisan Hua, who works on [Seedimagine](https://seedimagine.com/). This template calls OpenAI directly, not Seedimagine's API. No product endpoints or authentication are changed.
